_notes: Player powers. They cost nothing and are limited only by cooldown (seconds). Meteor damage is damage[0] + damage[1]*wave + damage[2]*wave*wave.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.description: Call a meteor onto the road. Heavy blast damage in an area, and the survivors burn.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.description: Freeze every creep in the area solid for 2.5s, then leave them slowed. Bosses are only slowed.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.description: Towers in the area attack twice as fast for 8 seconds.
